newsitem.title: CANADA: Cambiex sees positive Idaho copper assays.
newsitem.headline: Cambiex sees positive Idaho copper assays.

text.p: Cambiex Exploration Inc said on Thursday that new assay results from its Sultana copper-gold project in Idaho are "encouraging."
Nine new diamond drill holes have all intersected mineralization, the company said.

With 14 holes drilled so far, the drilling program continues to intersect significant near-surface copper, gold and silver within a mineralized zone about 300 metres wide metres wide by 1.5 km long, Cambiex said.
Less than half of the strike length of the target zone has been explored with diamond drilling.
The new holes show copper ranging from 0.27 percent to 2.74 percent over lengths ranging from 4.1 metres to 79.6 metres.
The hole showing copper at 2.74 percent was over a length of 4.1 metres.
Cambiex has a 15 percent interest in the Sutana project, owned by Cambior Inc. Cambiex can earn a 50 percent interest by spending US$5 million on the project.
